correctness.rationale: For original pre-update-table SAGA on scalar f_i(x)=a_i x^2/2, write state z=(x,y1,y2). Direct gradient-memory expansion yields exact 3×3 index matrices; second moments lift to six monomials. IID transition is (L(M1)+L(M2))/2 per step; independent random reshuffle transition (L(M2M1)+L(M1M2))/2 per epoch. At (a,b,eta)=(1,1,23/20), Q=[[253,-53,-53],[-53,230,-114],[-53,-114,230]] and iid mean residual Q-E[M_i^T Q M_i] have strictly positive leading principal minors (Q: 253,55381,8163120; residual: 563/400,789489/640000,5427/5120), proving all-initial-state geometric mean-square stability. At (1,4,27/100), epoch reshuffling Q=[[259,5,-34],[5,3,-3],[-34,-3,9]] has minors 259,752,1989 and residual positive minors 192531773/50000000, 7694776875239369/1600000000000000, 2268049442949819/640000000000000. Both sets of minors were recomputed exactly. For the opposite schemes, the source supplies full exact initialized rational generating functions for E[x_k^2] with denominators positive at 0, negative at 1, and numerator coprime to denominator; therefore an uncancelled real pole inside (0,1), giving limsup geometric growth along subsequences by Cauchy-Hadamard/nonnegative coefficients. Source exact six-monomial lift and rational-function verification algorithm were inspected, and independently constructed 3×3 matrices and first 0..3 grouped moments matched across direct path enumeration and lifted matrix propagation. Strict inequalities persist locally in parameters; no almost-sure divergence or full frontier claimed.
residual_risks: The unstable guarantee is existence of exponentially growing expected squared position error subsequences from one standard initialization, not every-start instability or almost-sure divergence.
The reshuffling scheme independently samples each epoch; alternative post-update-table algorithms are not covered.

originality.rationale: The original Defazio–Bach–Lacoste-Julien SAGA defines saved gradients at the previous iterate, which is crucial to these matrices. Ying–Yuan–Sayed 2017 random reshuffling variance reduction instead updates its selected stored gradient at the post-update point and proves convergence for sufficiently small steps, not this pre-update memory law. Qian–Qu–Richtárik 2019 studies iid arbitrary sampling sufficient bounds, not a bidirectional comparison. The same pre-update SAGA two-parameter counterexample pair was not found in materially inspected sources. Resultary nearby SARAH/STORM findings are different algorithms.
